title.signIn: This sign-in request could not be completed
title.signOut: This sign-out request could not be completed
refusal.general: The application's SAML request could not be answered.
refusal.STS-SAML-0001: This sign-in request has expired: it was held while you were at the sign-in screen, and it was held for too long.
refusal.STS-SAML-0002: The SAMLRequest sent to this page is not an AuthnRequest this service can read.
refusal.STS-SAML-0003: The AuthnRequest does not say which service provider sent it (it has no Issuer).
refusal.STS-SAML-0005: The address the response would be delivered to (the AssertionConsumerServiceURL) is not registered for this service provider, or none is registered.
refusal.STS-SAML-0006: The address the response would be delivered to is not an absolute http or https URL.
refusal.STS-SAML-0007: The AuthnRequest asks for a ProtocolBinding this service does not deliver a response on.
refusal.STS-SAML-0019: The SAMLRequest sent to this page is not a LogoutRequest this service can read.
refusal.STS-SAML-0020: The LogoutRequest names the person in an EncryptedID this service could not decrypt. Nothing was ended: you are still signed in.
refusal.STS-SAML-0061: The request's signature does not verify against any signing certificate registered for this service provider.
refusal.STS-SAML-0062: The request's signature could not be checked.
refusal.STS-SAML-0063: The request is not signed, or no certificate is registered to verify it with, and this service requires signed requests from this service provider.
refusal.STS-SAML-0073: The request is signed with SHA-1, which this service does not accept.
refusal.STS-SAML-0074: The metadata this service holds for this service provider has expired, so its requests are not accepted until newer metadata is loaded.
refusal.STS-SAML-0069: The AuthnRequest names an AssertionConsumerServiceIndex that is not in this service provider's metadata, or that this service cannot deliver to.
refusal.STS-SAML-0070: The AuthnRequest names an AssertionConsumerServiceURL that is not one of the endpoints in this service provider's metadata.
refusal.STS-SAML-0072: The AuthnRequest names no assertion consumer service, and none in this service provider's metadata is one this service can deliver to.
refusal.STS-SAML-0085: The request's Destination is not the address it was sent to, or a signed request names no Destination.
refusal.STS-SAML-0086: The request's IssueInstant is missing, not a valid time, in the future, or too old.
refusal.STS-SAML-0088: This AuthnRequest has been received before, so it is refused as a replay. Start the sign-in again from the application.
refusal.STS-SAML-0089: This service could not check whether the AuthnRequest had been answered before, so it refused it rather than risk answering it twice. Try again shortly.
refusal.STS-SAML-0091: Sign-in started at this identity provider is turned off for this service provider. Start the sign-in from the service provider.
refusal.STS-SAML-0092: This sign-in link does not say which service provider it is for.
refusal.STS-SAML-0093: This sign-in link asks for a binding a SAML Response cannot be delivered on.
refusal.STS-SAML-0103: The service provider that sent this AuthnRequest is not registered with this identity provider, so no response is sent to it.
refusal.STS-SAML-0104: The service provider that sent this LogoutRequest is not registered with this identity provider. Nothing was ended: you are still signed in.
refusal.STS-SAML-0110: This service is holding as many unanswered SAML artifacts as it is allowed to, so it cannot issue another one right now. Nothing was sent to the application. Try again shortly.
refusal.STS-KEYS-0070: The LogoutRequest's EncryptedID uses a key transport this service does not unwrap (rsa-1_5). Nothing was ended: you are still signed in.
refusal.STS-REG-0049: The address the response would be delivered to has been seen before but has not been confirmed for this application, so it is not used.
refusal.STS-SAML-0025: This sign-in has expired: it was held while you were at the sign-in screen, and it was held for too long.
refusal.STS-SAML-0026: This link names a profile other than the two SAML 1.1 browser profiles, post and artifact.
refusal.STS-SAML-0028: The address the response would be delivered to (the shire) is not registered for this relying party, or none is registered.
refusal.STS-SAML-0029: The address the response would be delivered to is not an absolute http or https URL.
refusal.STS-SAML-0030: This link does not say which relying party it is for: it has no providerId, and no TARGET to work one out from.
refusal.STS-SAML-0031: The sign-in was cancelled or did not succeed, so no assertion was sent.
refusal.STS-SAML-0032: You are signed in, but the policy of this service does not allow this application to receive an assertion for you.
refusal.STS-SAML-0102: This application does not allow the way you signed in.
refusal.STS-SAML-0105: The relying party this link is for is not registered with this identity provider.
refusal.STS-SAML-0109: This application does not allow the second factor you used to sign in.
refusal.STS-SAML-0113: Sign-in started at this identity provider is turned off for this relying party. Start the sign-in from the relying party.
refusal.STS-SAML-0114: Sign-in started by this relying party is turned off. It can be signed in to only from a link at this identity provider.
refusal.STS-SAML-0115: This sign-in still needs a stronger sign-in than the one you completed, so no assertion was sent.
refusal.STS-SAML-0117: The application asked for a phishing-resistant sign-in, and this sign-in did not provide one.
refusal.STS-SAML-0120: You chose not to sign in to this application, so nothing was sent to it.
refusal.STS-RISK-0017: This sign-in needs a second factor or a security key, and this page cannot ask for one.
refusal.STS-CORE-0121: This part of the service is being removed, so it no longer issues anything.
background.saml2: This is a page rather than a SAML Response because the request never got as far as naming somewhere this service may send one. Once an assertion consumer service is known, a failure is delivered there as a Response carrying a status code, as saml-core-2.0-os section 3.2.2 requires.
background.saml11: This is a page rather than a SAML Response because the SAML 1.1 browser profiles have no request message: the browser arrived here unsolicited, so there is nothing to answer and no InResponseTo to name. A failure sent to the relying party would be a document it never asked for.
background.paos: It is refused rather than quietly answered over HTTP POST, because a service provider that asked for PAOS and received a form post would conclude that PAOS worked.
background.authnFailed: The SAML 2.0 profile answers this with a Response carrying AuthnFailed, delivered to the service provider. SAML 1.1 cannot: there is no request to answer.
background.noAuthnContext: SAML 1.1 has no RequestedAuthnContext. The non-standard authnContextClassRef parameter named a phishing-resistant class, and this sign-in did not earn it. The SAML 2.0 profile answers the same fact with NoAuthnContext.
background.policy: The roles an application requires are on its application entry. The SAML 2.0 profile answers this with a Response carrying RequestDenied, delivered to the service provider; SAML 1.1 cannot, because there is no request to answer.
